question: who is saim chishti
answer: Hazrat Allama Saim Chishti (رحمۃ اللہ علیہ) ek mashhoor o maqbool Ahl-e-Sunnat scholar, intehaye behtareen mufassir, musannif, aur azeem naat go shayar hain jinhone deen o adab ki be-misaal khidmat ki hai.

question: hazrat allama saim chishti
answer: Hazrat Allama Saim Chishti (r.a) ka asal naam 'Ghulam Sarwar' tha lekin adabi dunya aur deeni halqon mein aap apne takhallus 'Saim Chishti' se mashhoor hain. Aapki shakhsiyat ilmi aur adabi hawale se nihayat buland darja rakhti hai.

question: saim chishti birth
answer: Hazrat Saim Chishti (r.a) ki pedaish December 1941 mein Bharat (India) ke shehar Amritsar (Punjab) ke ek deendar gharane mein hui. Baad mein aapka khandaan Pakistan hijrat kar gaya.

question: saim chishti death
answer: Hazrat Allama Saim Chishti (r.a) 22 January 2000 (15 Shawwal 1420 AH) ko is fani dunya se rukhsaat farmaye. Aapka mazar-e-aqdas Faisalabad, Pakistan mein marja-e-khalaq hai.

question: saim chishti education
answer: Aapne deeni taleem ke sath sath urdu, farsi aur arabi adab par mukammal dastaras hasil ki. Aapne maroof deeni madaris aur ulama-e-kiram se iktisab-e-faiz kiya aur silsila-e-Chishtia mein bait hue.

question: saim chishti books
answer: Hazrat Saim Chishti (r.a) ne taqreeban dunya ke har ahem deeni mozoo par qalam uthaya. Aapki mashhoor kutub mein 'Iman-e-Abi Talib', 'Al-Batool', 'Mushkil Kusha', aur deegar kayi ilmi tasanif shamil hain.

question: saim chishti translations
answer: Allama Saim Chishti ne arabi ki kayi azeem kutub ke aasan urdu tarajim kiye, jin mein Imam Fakhruddin Razi ki 'Tafsir al-Kabir' aur Hazrat Ibn Arabi ki 'Futuhat-al-Makkiyyah' ke tarajim aur tashreeh nihayat qabil-e-zikr hain.

question: institutions established by saim chishti
answer: Aapne ilmi, deeni aur shairana silsile ko aage barhane ke liye 'Saim Chishti Research Center' ki bunyad rakhi jahan se aaj bhi unki kutub aur deeni khidmat ko aam kiya ja raha hai.

question: saim chishti poetry
answer: Hazrat Saim Chishti ka kalam Ishq-e-Rasool (ﷺ) aur Ahl-e-Bait ki mohabbat se bhara hua hai. Unki naatein aur manqabat dunya bhar ke naat khwan nihayat aqeedat se parhte hain. Unka shairana andaz nihayat sada aur asar-angez hai.

question: saim chishti family
answer: Hazrat Saim Chishti (r.a) ke teen betay hain jinhone aapke ilmi aur deeni virsay ko zinda rakha hua hai: Al-Haj Latif Sajid Chishti, Shafiq Mujahid Chishti, aur Tauseef Haider Chishti.

question: saim chishti sons
answer: Hazrat Saim Chishti (r.a) ke teenon sahebzadein (Latif Sajid Chishti, Shafiq Mujahid Chishti, aur Tauseef Haider Chishti) apne walid-e-giraami ke naatiya o ilmi silsile ko khubsoorati se chalaye hue hain.

question: saim chishti research center
answer: Saim Chishti Research Center aik ahem idara hai jo Hazrat Saim Chishti ki kutub ki dobara chapaayi (publishing), unke audio-video kalam ki hifazat aur unki ilmi miraas ko dunya tak pohnchane ka kaam karta hai.
